how_to_apply: Fill in the application form for Junior Resident (Dental), which is annexed to the notice.
Paste a duly attested passport-size photograph in the box on the form.

Fill in your personal details, valid DMC/DDC/D.C.I No., date of internship completion, academic qualifications (year of passing, university/institution, % of marks, number of attempts), work experience and Aadhaar Number. Write your email id in capital letters.
Sign the declaration and add the date and place.
Attach self-attested photocopies of the documents listed below.
Send the application by post, or hand it in personally, at Room No 136, Diary Section, Ist Floor, Bhagwan Mahavir Hospital, Pitam Pura Delhi-110034, so that it reaches by 24 October 2026, 01.00 pm.
Applications received after the due date and time will not be considered. Any delay in the post will not be considered either.
important_instructions: No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the written exam/interview. If any information given in the application form is found false or incorrect, the candidature or service may be terminated.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice says the post will be filled in phases, depending on the vacancies available and what the department needs. The number of vacancies may change.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: Internship window: candidates must have completed their internship between 24/10/2024 and 23/10/2026. Registration: registration with the Dental Council of India is compulsory. Candidates registered with another state dental council may still appear, but they will have to register with the Dental Council of India if appointed. Former Junior Residents: a candidate who has already completed one year of Junior Residency may be allowed to appear for the interview again. That candidate will be offered the residency only if no fresh junior resident (one who has not completed a year of junior residency) is available. The age limit for the Junior Resident (Dental) post is 40 years for General, as on 24/10/2026. Reservation for handicapped candidates will be given as per rules. For the full eligibility conditions of the Junior Resident (Dental) post, candidates should check the official notification.

rows.qualification: BDS Degree from a recognized University/institution. Registration with Dental Council of India is compulsory.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The appointment is purely on an adhoc basis. The first appointment is for 89 days. Based on satisfactory work and conduct, it may be extended till 01 year, with a one-day break after every 89-day term. Hostel accommodation is compulsory for the Junior Resident. Appointment depends on medical fitness and on verification of educational certificates.

rows.pay_level_pay: As per Pay Matrix, at Level-10 (Rs. 56,100 - 1,77,500), plus usual allowance as admissible under the rules

content_sections.heading: Selection Process and Schedule
content_sections.text: Candidates will be selected through a written exam/screening test and an interview. First the application forms are scrutinised. The list of eligible candidates is then put on the Delhi Government website, and the written exam/screening test and interview are held for those candidates. The result will be displayed on the Delhi Government website. The notice says the list of eligible candidates will be shown on the Delhi Health Services website along with other details.

rows.event: Last date for receiving application along with documents (self attested)
Uploading of the list of eligible candidates for written examination/screening test on Delhi Government Website (after screening)
Written exam/screening test and interview of eligible candidates

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BMH Delhi Junior Resident (Dental)
content_sections.text: Fill in the application form for Junior Resident (Dental), which is annexed to the notice. Paste a duly attested passport-size photograph in the box on the form. Fill in your personal details, valid DMC/DDC/D.C.I No., date of internship completion, academic qualifications (year of passing, university/institution, % of marks, number of attempts), work experience and Aadhaar Number. Write your email id in capital letters. Sign the declaration and add the date and place. Attach self-attested photocopies of the documents listed below. Send the application by post, or hand it in personally, at Room No 136, Diary Section, Ist Floor, Bhagwan Mahavir Hospital, Pitam Pura Delhi-110034, so that it reaches by 24 October 2026, 01.00 pm. Applications received after the due date and time will not be considered. Any delay in the post will not be considered either.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Date of Birth Certificate (Xth class) BDS Degree Dental Council of India/State Dental Council/Delhi Dental Council registration Internship Certificate Attempt Certificate Mark-Sheets of all terms Aadhar Card/Voter Card/Driving Licence/Valid Passport Duly attested passport-size photograph pasted on the application form All the relevant certificates should be self-attested.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the written exam/interview. If any information given in the application form is found false or incorrect, the candidature or service may be terminated.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in BMH Delhi Recruitment 2026 for Junior Resident (Dental)?
faq.answer: Bhagwan Mahavir Hospital has advertised 1 Junior Resident (Dental) post, reserved for UR, on an adhoc basis. The number of vacancies may change.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the BMH Delhi Junior Resident (Dental) post?
faq.answer: Applications must reach Room No 136, Diary Section, Bhagwan Mahavir Hospital by 24 October 2026, 01.00 pm. Applications that arrive late, including those delayed in the post, will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for BMH Delhi Junior Resident (Dental)?
faq.answer: You need a BDS Degree from a recognized University/institution, with the internship completed between 24/10/2024 and 23/10/2026. Registration with the Dental Council of India is compulsory.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the BMH Delhi Junior Resident (Dental) post?
faq.answer: The age limit is 40 years for General, as on 24/10/2026. Reservation for handicapped candidates will be given as per rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a Junior Resident (Dental) at Bhagwan Mahavir Hospital?
faq.answer: The pay is at Level-10 of the Pay Matrix (Rs. 56,100 - 1,77,500), plus the usual allowance admissible under the rules.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for BMH Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form annexed to the notice and attach self-attested photocopies of the listed documents. Send it by post, or hand it in personally, at Room No 136, Diary Section, Ist Floor, Bhagwan Mahavir Hospital, Pitam Pura Delhi-110034, so that it reaches by 24 October 2026, 01.00 pm.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for BMH Delhi Junior Resident (Dental)?
faq.answer: Selection is through a written exam/screening test and an interview of eligible candidates. The list of eligible candidates will be uploaded on 28 October 2026, and the exam and interview dates will be announced later.

faq.question: Q8. Is the BMH Delhi Junior Resident (Dental) post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is purely on an adhoc basis. It starts for 89 days and may be extended till 01 year, depending on satisfactory work and conduct, with a one-day break after every 89-day term.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates registered with a state dental council apply?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates registered with another state dental council may appear, but they must register with the Dental Council of India if they are appointed.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for the BMH Delhi written exam or interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the written exam/interview.
